warning_texts: This profile is single-vendor. The architect, the workers, the auditors and this red team all ran on claude-opus-5, so a mistake the model family tends to make can appear on both sides of every check, and no cross-vendor or GPT gate exists in this system. Write protection over raw_data and the frozen machinery came from permissions.deny, which covers the edit tools and not the shell. A modified raw file would have been caught afterwards by the control lock, not prevented.

The LLM layer before this step provided no real evidence. All four worker results, gate0_semantic and gate_release_auditor carry only one placeholder check (0.473684 against 0.473684) that matches no number in this audit. Their summaries and evidence notes say 'driver e2e', and their created_at of 2

The dashboard test cards show a bare 'effect' with no name or unit (0.1197 for completion, 0.4869 for AOV), so a dashboard reader cannot tell a proportion difference from Cohen's d. This is the same confusion as the R04 blocker, and no rule checks it.

Both test p-values are shown as 0.0000 (registry 0E-10; my recalculation gives p of about 2.9e-157 for z = 26.72, and far smaller for t = 42.70), which reads as a p of exactly zero rather than one below 0.0001.

The completion rate is delivered-as-of-the-export, not a final outcome. Pending orders are in the denominator as the spec requires (direct 3,457 = 14.1%, partner 4,034 = 20.2%). Without them the rates would be 0.842857 and 0.758176 instead of 0.724397 and 0.604746, so part of the 0.1197 channel gap

None of the five RESOLVED decisions in human_decisions.yaml looks wrong on the data. The most consequential is latest_revision_wins: 126 of 917 repeated orders change status between revisions, all towards delivered (61 from pending, 65 cancellations reversed). Keeping the first revision instead woul
Excluding orders with a negative refund removes 10 in-quarter orders (8 delivered, 9 direct). Including them with the absolute refund would add 10 orders and 645.29 EUR to net revenue.

The slashed-date decision (month-first) holds: 0 of 6,852 slashed dates disagree with order_month, and 231 of them would also fit day-first. All 4,555 ISO-8601 Z timestamps fall on the same date in Europe/Warsaw as in UTC. Because the period is taken on order_month, no published number depends on da

The unpublished shipping_total of 37,792,722.50 EUR matches my own locale-aware parse order by order (2,648 unreadable cells zeroed, 5.9%). A strip-everything reading would give 1,248,402,183.11. The per-order shipping values in the export run to hundreds and even thousands of EUR against gross amou

The release contract's text exclusion for 'n = digits' in report.md means no machine check ties the printed n to the claim. I checked all four by hand (24597, 19934, 17818, 12055) and they match, but a wrong n would pass the release gate.

CLM-TEST-CHANNEL-AOV's population text leaves out the delivered-only filter, although its n_per_group (17,818 and 12,055) are delivered orders. The AOV estimate caveats say 'one quarter of orders in this channel' without saying delivered-only.

The analysis plan applies one unitless effect_floor of 0.02 to both a proportion difference and a Cohen's d, where it means different things. It does not bite here because both effects are far above it.

The test claims carry a tolerance of 0.0001 on p, the statistic and the effect, including the proportion-difference effect, which is looser than the 0.000001 contract default for a proportion. My recalculation matches the registry to 1e-6, so no number moves.

I could not establish the following. First, whether R01 to R05 answer the questions as asked, because raw_data/questions.md is not among my inputs. Second, the control totals against the client's export log, because raw_data is not among my inputs. Third, whether the carries pass carry.schema.json,

The check_plan leaves a lot to judgement, and this red team is the only check on it. Nothing machine-checks the renamed columns customer_id, order_date and country (I found 0 mismatches), the per-order shipping values (0 mismatches), an answer file's hypothesis block, n and labels on the dashboard,
